steps.title: Analyze existing Modern Calculator project
steps.description: Inspect existing codebase, layouts, and dependencies to pinpoint build issues.

steps.title: Identify prohibited dependencies
steps.description: Locate the unauthorized nanohttpd external library inside app/build.gradle.

steps.title: Remove third-party dependencies
steps.description: Eliminate the nanohttpd implementation statement to satisfy strict zero-dependency build rules.

steps.title: Update packaging block structure
steps.description: Convert deprecated packagingOptions syntax into packaging blocks compatible with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2.

steps.title: Validate manifest namespace settings
steps.description: Double check standard Android URI attributes across XML structures to block build failures.

steps.title: Validate drawables configuration
steps.description: Verify custom shape selector states compile and render with consistent backgrounds.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 compliance
steps.description: Review MainActivity.java to assert that only valid Java 8 features (no lambdas, stream APIs) are employed.

steps.title: Review sound effects configuration
steps.description: Assure correct operation of the fallback ToneGenerator system for button tap audios.

steps.title: Validate expression evaluation parser
steps.description: Check correctness of multi-character parsing loop with strict zero-division exceptions handled properly.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Assemble clean build of Modern Calculator debug package.
